sources.title: Amantadine hydrochloride capsules, USP
sources.issuer: Upsher-Smith Laboratories, LLC; label hosted by NLM DailyMed
sources.agent_review_notes: The full label provides therapeutic, pharmacology and harm evidence. It reports fatal overdose and renal-impairment accumulation, psychiatric effects, seizure cautions and problems after abrupt cessation. These clinical phenomena do not establish recreational prevalence, a safe nonmedical dose or recreational tolerance-reset timelines. Its antiviral indication must be read beside current resistance guidance.

sources.title: GOCOVRI (amantadine) extended-release capsules
sources.issuer: Supernus Pharmaceuticals, Inc.; label hosted by NLM DailyMed
sources.agent_review_notes: This formulation is indicated for levodopa-treated Parkinson disease dyskinesia and adjunctive treatment of off episodes. The label describes weak uncompetitive NMDA antagonism while stating that the mechanism of clinical efficacy is unknown. Product-specific evidence must retain the formulation and patient context rather than becoming a general recreational-effects claim.

sources.title: Influenza Antiviral Drug Resistance
sources.issuer: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
locators: Understanding Reduced Susceptibility and Antiviral Resistance
Status of Reduced Susceptibility and Antiviral Resistance in the United States
sources.agent_review_notes: Amantadine and rimantadine are M2 blockers active against influenza A, not B. CDC does not recommend adamantanes for circulating seasonal influenza A because widespread resistance makes them unsuitable. The scope is US seasonal influenza and the inspected guidance date; historical labeling should not be presented as a current recommendation.

sources.title: Venlafaxine hydrochloride extended-release capsules
sources.issuer: Aurobindo Pharma USA, Inc.; label hosted by NLM DailyMed
sources.agent_review_notes: The ER product is an SNRI indicated for adult major depression, generalized anxiety, social anxiety and panic disorder. Label evidence covers suicidality in younger patients, serotonin syndrome, elevated blood pressure and discontinuation symptoms. Section 9 reports no drug-seeking signal in clinical studies but says abuse was not systematically studied, so this cannot establish no misuse risk or Chinese-community prevalence. Treatment discontinuation is distinct from evidence of addiction or a recreational tolerance timeline.
